items.label: Acoustic ceiling tile grid ceiling, 9'-3" AFF
items.instanceNote: A120 hatches Sales 022 as ACT grid at 9'-3"; A510.2 corroborates 9'-3". ACT tile size (2'x2' vs 2'x4') is not readable at 3/32" per A120.md - confirm before ordering grid or tile. Note the draft's PT-07 "ceiling paint" line sits against an ACT lid, and no PT code is printed at this space on A510.2 (A510.2.md: no PT codes on that sheet) - see report.
